newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire rebel leader Kabila leaves Kisangani.
newsitem.headline: Zaire rebel leader Kabila leaves Kisangani.

text.p: Zairean rebel leader Laurent Kabila and top rebel officials flew out of Zaire's third largest city Kisangani on Wednesday amid tight security, witnesses said.
Kabila was heading for the eastern Zairean border city of Goma, according to Raphael Nghenda, information commissioner for the Alliance of Democratic Forces for the Liberation Congo-Zaire.
Kabila would conduct some business in Goma before continuing to another location for a meeting and would return to Kisangani in three days, a senior alliance official told Reuters.
The official said he did not know where Kabila would go after Goma.
"(Kabila) is returning to Goma because he has business there," Ghenda said.
A rebel delegation was in Lome, Togo, on Wednesday for an Organisation of Africa Unity summit on the Zaire crisis. Kabila and President Mobutu Sese Seko had not been expected in Togo.
